messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Elevated 5xx error rate detected for /v1/generate in eu-west-1. Rolling 1m alert — 5xx spike from 0.3% -> 12% over last 3m. Paging oncall: @sophie (oncall).
sophie (oncall): I see it. I'm on it. Is this global or just eu-west?
ken (eng-runtime): Grafana shows spike only in eu-west-1. Latency up too. Error ratio mostly 502/503 from gateway. Traces point to env-proxy -> model-backend cluster.
maria (eng-sre): I'm pulling envoy logs. Seeing a lot of 503: upstream overflow + 524 timeouts. Circuit_breaker stats show high ejected hosts.
tom (prod-support): Customer reports: "models failing intermittently for EU users" — several big customers on eu cluster. We should prepare -postmortem and customer comms. Chun, can you draft a quick note for affected customers?
chun (customer-success): On it. I'll wait for impact window and a short root-cause explanation.
sophie (oncall): Ken/Maria — can we triage if this is config or a runtime overload? Any recent deploys?
ken (eng-runtime): No infra deploys in last hour. There was a routing weight change pushed by traffic-svc at 02:11 UTC to shift traffic to new model-group (A/B rollout). I suspect a misweight that sent >95% to a small pool causing circuit breakers.
maria (eng-sre): Confirmed — envoy cluster stats: cluster:model-eu-group-b had 6 hosts, 4 marked unhealthy, local_missed_requests increasing. Retries configured at LB layer are enabled (retry_on:5xx, connect-failure, retriable-status-codes). Looks like retry amplification + CB eviction -> retry storm and 503s.
sophie (oncall): OK immediate mitigations: 1) disable LB-level retries for /v1/generate 2) bump max_connections and reduce circuit-breaker ejection thresholds 3) shift routing weight back to stable group. Ken, can you run commands? Maria, coordinate oncall steps.
ken (eng-runtime): Running quick change now — disabling retries on route. Command: 
```bash
# patch envoy route to remove retry policy
curl -X PATCH http://config-api.local/clusters/model-eu-route -d '{"retry_policy": null}'
```
Applying...
ken (eng-runtime): Patch applied, envoy reloads.
maria (eng-sre): Watching metrics... 60s window shows 5xx down from 12% -> 6% and error latency dropping. But still elevated.
sophie (oncall): Next: revert weight change. Ken, what’s the weight delta?
ken (eng-runtime): Traffic-svc applied weights: model-eu-group-b=0.95, model-eu-group-a=0.05. I'll flip to 0.2/0.8 to relieve group-b while we stabilize.
ken (eng-runtime): Pushed weight update via traffic-svc: `trafficctl set-weight model-eu 0.8 0.2` (group-a/group-b). Confirming rollout.
maria (eng-sre): After weight change, host ejections dropping, 5xx now 1.8% in last 2m. Appears to be stabilizing. Still monitoring for flapping.
tom (prod-support): Customers reporting partial recovery. Applause emoji from some users. I'll send interim update: "We identified a routing configuration that concentrated traffic on a small host pool causing gateway errors. We’ve rolled back the weight and disabled retries. Recovery in progress." Ready to send? Chun?
chun (customer-success): Yes, send now. I'll include ETA for full recovery 15-30m and offer a postmortem when available.
sophie (oncall): Action items: - Ken: Keep retry policy disabled until we confirm cluster stability. - Maria: Tune circuit breaker thresholds and investigate why hosts were marked unhealthy (OOM? slow startup?). - Ken: Add guardrail in traffic-svc to prevent >80% single-group weight in eu region. - Tom/Chun: Customer comms and ticket prioritization.
ken (eng-runtime): Will keep a watch and push guardrail PR; will not re-enable retries until green for 30m.
maria (eng-sre): I'll check host health: initial signs point to memory pressure on model-group-b instances — need to correlate with recent model variant memory usage. Creating a follow-up ticket.
sophie (oncall): Thanks team. Reactions: :thumbsup:. Keep thread updated. If 5xx < 0.5% for 30m, I'll close paging.
incident-bot: Incident annotated: Sev-2 incident created (INC-2026-0412-1852). Oncall: @sophie. Timeline and actions recorded.
ken (eng-runtime): Noted — starting guardrail PR now.
maria (eng-sre): Noted — will attach heap/oom logs to the incident ticket.
chun (customer-success): Sent customer note. Received a couple of replies asking for postmortem and compensation questions — forwarding to Tom.
sophie (oncall): Final check 15m: 5xx 0.4%, latency normal. I'm keeping paging open for another 15m then will close. Good job everyone."
